about: A reviewed one-line summary of each gap ID whose definitions word the loss differently (TestKnownGaps in this package). An ID with differing wordings and no summary fails the test: decide whether the wordings are one loss (write its summary here) or two (renumber one). KNOWN_GAPS.md shows the summary as the ID's loss.

summaries.A1: Azure's per-choice content filter verdicts (content_filter_results: category, severity, filtered, protected material) are dropped, so a client cannot see why a completion was cut to finish_reason "content_filter"
summaries.A2: Azure On Your Data's message.context (retrieved citations, detected intent) is dropped, so answers grounded on data_sources reach the client with [docN] markers and no citations
summaries.A3: Each image's content and prompt filter verdicts (hate, self_harm, sexual, violence, jailbreak, profanity) are dropped; models.ImageData has no field for them, so a client cannot see why an image was filtered
summaries.A4: A content-filter rejection's inner error (code ResponsibleAIPolicyViolation, the per-category verdicts, an image request's rejected revised_prompt) is dropped; parseProviderError keeps message, type and code, so the client cannot tell which category blocked the prompt
summaries.A8: Azure's model list fields are not read: created_at (every model lists created 0), capabilities, lifecycle_status, deprecation dates and status are dropped; models.ModelObject has none of them
summaries.A9: The audio duration Azure reports and bills by passes through to the client but is not read: the gateway prices a transcription from the uploaded WAV's length, so a non-WAV upload is unpriced
summaries.B1: parseStreamPayload decodes the InvokeModelWithResponseStream chunk envelope {"bytes": <base64 Anthropic event>} as if it were the event and never reads bytes, so every InvokeModel stream yields no content, no finish_reason and no usage
summaries.B16: A mid-stream exception's payload is not decoded: every exception becomes a 502 upstream_error with the raw JSON as its message, so a throttlingException (429), modelTimeoutException (408) or modelStreamErrorException (424) is retried, failed over and counted as a server error
summaries.B17: A ModelErrorException's originalStatusCode and resourceName are dropped; parseBedrockError keeps only the message, so the canonical error cannot say whether the model failed with a 4xx or a 5xx
summaries.B2: Converse reasoningContent (reasoning text, signature, redactedContent) is dropped, stream and non-stream, so no reasoning_content or thinking_blocks reach the client and a Claude tool-use turn with reasoning cannot be replayed
summaries.B20: Server-side tools are not translated on either API (Converse server_tool_use toolUse and toolResult blocks, starts and deltas; InvokeModel server_tool_use and *_tool_result blocks and the code-execution container): their calls and results are dropped
summaries.B3: thinking and redacted_thinking blocks are dropped whole on the InvokeModel path, signatures included; Anthropic requires them passed back unchanged in a tool-use turn
summaries.B4: stopReason guardrail_intervened falls back to "stop", so a response a guardrail blocked looks like a normal completion; "content_filter" is the canonical reason
summaries.B6: stopReason model_context_window_exceeded falls back to "stop" on both APIs; the response was truncated, so "length" is the honest canonical reason
summaries.B8: Converse prompt-cache read and write tokens (cacheReadInputTokens, cacheWriteInputTokens) are dropped instead of counted in prompt_tokens / cached_tokens, so usage and cost under-count cached requests (0 today: the gateway never sends a cachePoint)
summaries.B9: InvokeModel prompt-cache read and write tokens are dropped instead of counted in prompt_tokens / cached_tokens, stream and non-stream, so usage and cost under-count cached requests
summaries.C2: Web-search citations lose encrypted_index, which Anthropic needs passed back to continue a conversation that cites search results (url, title and cited_text survive as url_citation annotations)
summaries.CA1: Cartesia's pcm_f16le encoding (2 bytes a sample) has no width in the meter, so a transcription session in it is refused with 400 unmeterable_audio
summaries.DG2: Deepgram's Flux streaming APIs (/v2/listen and /v2/speak) are not relayed: a client gets 404 unknown_endpoint
summaries.G10: Server-side tool parts are dropped: executableCode and codeExecutionResult (code_execution), and the toolCall / toolResponse parts of Google Search, URL context, Maps and File Search; the caller gets the final text without them and cannot replay the turn
summaries.G11: Per-category safety ratings, including which category blocked the answer, are dropped; finish_reason content_filter says only that something was filtered
summaries.G12: Gemini's responseId is dropped and the canonical id is a gateway-generated gen-<nanos>, so a response cannot be traced back to Google
summaries.G13: The per-modality token breakdowns (prompt, output, cache: TEXT, IMAGE, AUDIO, VIDEO, DOCUMENT) are dropped, on the chat path and in native GenAI billing, so audio and image tokens are priced as text
summaries.G18: Native GenAI billing (genaifmt.ExtractUsageMetadata) ignores cachedContentTokenCount and toolUsePromptTokenCount: cached prompt tokens are billed at the full input rate, and tool-result input Google bills is never billed
summaries.G19: error.details is dropped (RetryInfo.retryDelay, ErrorInfo.reason, quota violations), so a 429 carries no retry hint and the gateway cannot tell its own credential's failure from the client's
summaries.G2: The long-decode continuationToken is dropped: the gateway neither follows it nor lets a client send it back, so output past the per-request cap is unreachable
summaries.G20: mapGeminiStatus knows only INVALID_ARGUMENT, UNAUTHENTICATED, PERMISSION_DENIED, NOT_FOUND and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, so a client error such as FAILED_PRECONDITION or OUT_OF_RANGE becomes a retryable 502 that is failed over and counted against the circuit breaker
summaries.G21: An error body wrapped in a one-element JSON array does not decode, so parseGeminiError falls back to a 502 whose message is the raw body: a rate limit is retried at once and failed over
summaries.G22: StreamGenerateContent turns an upstream 4xx into a 502 whose message is the raw body, so a streaming google-genai client gets 502 INTERNAL instead of the upstream's 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and its RetryInfo
summaries.G23: The embedding usage Gemini reports (usageMetadata.promptTokenCount, what embeddings are priced in) is dropped: the canonical usage is hard-coded 0, and the native embedContent route bills request characters, so embeddings are never billed correctly
summaries.G24: The TTS usageMetadata (audio output tokens, what Gemini TTS is priced in) is decoded and thrown away; the speech route bills input characters
summaries.G25: usageMetadata.serviceTier (standard, flex, priority) is not read, on the chat path or in native GenAI billing, so a flex or priority request is priced at the standard rate
summaries.G3: A malformed function call (finishReason MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL) falls back to "stop" with no content and no tool call, and finishMessage, the text saying why generation stopped, is dropped: the caller sees an empty, normal-looking completion
summaries.G4: A blocked prompt (promptFeedback.blockReason, no candidates; on Vertex AI also blockReasonMessage) becomes a 200 with an empty choices array and no content_filter finish_reason, and its stream emits nothing: no chunk, no finish_reason, no usage, no error
summaries.G7: Grounding detail beyond web groundingChunks is dropped: which span each source supports, the search queries, the Search suggestions widget that Grounding with Google Search requires apps to show, and image, Maps and File Search sources; streams drop the sources entirely
summaries.G8: url_context retrieval status per URL (SUCCESS, ERROR, PAYWALL, UNSAFE) is dropped, so a caller cannot tell whether the model read the page it was given
summaries.G9: toolUsePromptTokenCount (tool results fed back to the model, billed as input) is not added to prompt_tokens, so usage and cost under-count the request and total_tokens no longer equals prompt + completion
summaries.GQ1: Groq's parsed reasoning (message.reasoning) is dropped; models.Message has reasoning_content, the canonical slot, but nothing maps one to the other
summaries.GQ2: Groq's streamed reasoning (delta.reasoning) is dropped; models.Delta has reasoning_content, the canonical slot, but nothing maps one to the other
summaries.GQ4: The results of Groq's built-in tools (executed_tools: compound models' web search, code execution, browser automation) are dropped, stream and non-stream
summaries.K1: The stream parser reads finish_reason and usage from the top level of message-end, where Cohere never sends them (they are under delta), so every stream ends with "stop" whatever the real reason and reports no usage
summaries.K3: Citations (cited span, text and the tool output or document it came from) are dropped, stream and non-stream; the canonical message has annotations but the adapter emits none
summaries.K4: A reasoning model's thinking is dropped (thinking content blocks and deltas) instead of becoming reasoning_content
summaries.K5: The tool plan (the model's stated reasoning before its tool calls) is dropped, stream and non-stream; Cohere expects it back as tool_plan on the next turn
summaries.K7: A failed generation reaches the client as a success: lookupCohereFinishReason maps ERROR to "stop", and a stream that fails mid-generation loses its error message
summaries.K8: translateRerankResponse reports billed_units.input_tokens as search_units, and cohereBilledUnits has no search_units field, so a search-unit bill is read as 0 (priced at the one-unit fallback) and a token-billed rerank is priced as that many searches
summaries.K9: encoding_format and dimensions are not forwarded: the adapter always asks for embedding_types ["float"] and never sends output_dimension, so a client asking for base64 or a smaller vector gets default-size float arrays
summaries.O1: message.refusal is dropped (models.Message has no refusal field), so a structured-outputs refusal reaches the client as content null with no explanation and finish_reason "stop"
summaries.O10: The Responses translator drops reasoning output items and events (summary, reasoning text, encrypted_content), so a chat client of a Responses-served route gets no reasoning_content and cannot pass encrypted reasoning back
summaries.O11: input_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens is dropped (responsesUsage reads cached_tokens only), so prompt-cache writes, which gpt-5.6 and later bill separately, cannot be priced
summaries.O13: output_text annotations (url_citation, file_citation) are dropped: models.Message.annotations exists but the Responses translator never fills it, so web-search citations vanish
summaries.O17: The /v1/responses passthrough bills input and output tokens only: cached and cache-write tokens are ignored (a cached prompt is priced at the full rate, cache writes not at all) and reasoning tokens get no breakdown
summaries.O18: Transcription and translation usage (token or duration) passes through to the client but is never read: the server prices them from the uploaded WAV's duration, so token-billed gpt-4o-*-transcribe models are priced by the wrong unit and non-WAV uploads go unpriced
summaries.O19: models.ImageResponse has no field for the image response metadata (background, output_format, quality, size) or usage.output_tokens_details, so the client loses what the image was rendered as and image and text output tokens cannot be priced apart
summaries.O2: delta.refusal is dropped (models.Delta has no refusal field), so a streamed refusal reaches the client as empty deltas
summaries.O23: A model's retirement date (OpenAI's shutdown_date, OpenRouter's expiration_date, Mistral's deprecation) is dropped from ListModels; models.ModelObject has no field for the one machine-readable deprecation signal
summaries.O3: Streamed choice logprobs are dropped (models.StreamChoice has no logprobs field), so a stream with logprobs: true carries none to the client; the non-stream path keeps them
summaries.O30: A failed Responses response or stream keeps only the error message: type, code and param are dropped, and the stream ends with a generic 502
summaries.O32: The legacy function_call (deprecated functions parameter) is dropped from messages and deltas; the canonical types have only tool_calls
summaries.O4: A custom tool call's payload (custom.name and custom.input) is dropped: models.ToolCall only has function, so the client receives a tool call of type "custom" with an empty name and empty arguments
summaries.OR1: OpenRouter's error code is an integer and models.ErrorDetail.Code a string, so no OpenRouter error body decodes: a 400, 401, 402 or 429 becomes a retryable 502 with the raw body as its message
summaries.OR2: OpenRouter's normalized reasoning and reasoning_details are dropped, stream and non-stream; nothing maps them to reasoning_content or thinking_blocks, so the reasoning and the signatures needed to continue it never reach the client
summaries.OR4: OpenRouter's usage cost (cost, cost_details, is_byok) is dropped for embeddings: models.EmbeddingUsage has no Extra, so the client loses what OpenRouter charged
summaries.OR5: The error's metadata (the upstream provider's raw error and error_type, a 403's moderation reasons or guardrail matches) is dropped, so a client cannot tell which provider failed or why
summaries.S2: The refusal category and explanation (stop_details) are dropped, and stop_reason refusal itself is unmapped, so a caller cannot tell a refusal from a normal stop
summaries.S3: stop_reason model_context_window_exceeded falls back to "stop"; the response was truncated, so "length" is the honest canonical reason
summaries.T1: Thinking-block signatures are dropped (anthropicContentBlock has no signature field), so thinking_blocks reach the inbound translator unsigned and a multi-turn tool-use conversation with thinking cannot be replayed to Anthropic
summaries.T4: The stream parser drops thinking entirely (thinking blocks, thinking_delta, signature_delta): streamed responses carry no reasoning_content and no signatures, unlike the non-stream path
summaries.TG3: Together's top_logprobs, reported beside the choice rather than inside logprobs, are dropped, stream and non-stream
summaries.TG4: Together's "eos" finish reason passes through unmapped: it is not a canonical finish reason, so the inbound translators fall back to a default and clients that switch on finish_reason miss it
summaries.U1: Prompt-cache read and write tokens are not counted in prompt_tokens / prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (Anthropic's input_tokens excludes both), so usage and cost under-count cached requests
summaries.U7: usage.speed (fast mode, billed at a premium) and usage.inference_geo (the serving region) are dropped, so the cost accounting cannot see either pricing modifier
summaries.U8: The native /v1/messages passthrough bills from anthropicfmt.ExtractUsage / StreamUsageScanner, which read only input_tokens and output_tokens: cache reads and writes (and the 5m / 1h write split), service tier, fast mode and inference region are never billed, so every cached Claude Code turn is under-billed
summaries.V1: Vertex AI's usageMetadata.trafficType (on-demand, priority, flex, provisioned throughput) is dropped, so provisioned-throughput, priority and flex requests are priced as pay-as-you-go on-demand
summaries.V3: Vertex AI's embedding truncated flag is dropped, so a client cannot tell its input was cut to the model's limit before it was embedded
summaries.X11: Server tools other than web search (code execution, bash and text-editor code execution, web fetch, tool search, programmatic tool calling, the code-execution container) are not translated: their blocks, results and container are dropped
summaries.X2: The request_id of an error body (and the request-id header) is dropped, so a failed request cannot be traced back to Anthropic in logs or a support ticket
summaries.X3: The retry-after header (and every anthropic-ratelimit-* header) is dropped; models.APIError has no retry field, so the gateway's retry, failover and the client's backoff ignore when Anthropic says to come back
summaries.X4: mapAnthropicStatus maps by error type and ignores the HTTP status, so an error type it does not list (billing_error, timeout_error, conflict_error, request_too_large) becomes a retryable 502 upstream_error that is failed over and counted against the circuit breaker
summaries.X5: error.details (the machine-readable error_code such as enforced_spend_limit_reached, and appeal_url) is dropped, so a spend-cap 429 that keeps failing until next month reaches the router and the client as an ordinary rate limit
summaries.X7: StreamAnthropicMessage turns every upstream error status into a 502 ErrUpstreamProvider, so a streaming /v1/messages client (Claude Code) gets a retryable 502 api_error instead of Anthropic's own 429, 400, 401 or 404 and its body
